title: Customers, Content, and Growth
description: Manage customer engagement, store content, marketing, and reporting features available to your business.
content:
Use the customer and growth features enabled for your store to support shoppers and promote the business. Follow consent, privacy, and content-approval requirements.

## Customer Records and Engagement

Search for the right customer before opening a record. Some stores support customer groups or approved lists. Avoid duplicates and collect only the information needed for the task.

<Screenshot alt="BeautyComm customer groups" label="Add a screenshot of customer records or groups with personal data obscured" />

Reviews and product questions should be handled using the store’s moderation rules. Answer accurately and remove inappropriate content only through the approved process. If consultations or recommendations are enabled, check details carefully and handle personal or health-related information with care.

## Promotions and Rewards

Before publishing an offer, verify its terms, eligible products, dates, and usage limits. Where memberships, points, or referrals are enabled, follow the current program rules and check the related order before correcting a balance.

Other available campaigns may include influencers, donations, testimonials, or product labels such as **Skin Type** and **Good For**. Confirm campaign terms and obtain required consent before publishing customer content. Product labels must be accurate and are not medical advice.

## Content and Community

The store may include blog articles, beauty content, community posts, and Glowtube video content. Follow the editorial process: check the text, images, links, audience, and publication timing before publishing. Moderate comments and reports according to community rules, and avoid exposing a reporter’s personal details.

Use only media approved for publication. Check that uploaded files are used by the intended content before replacing or removing them.

## Marketing and Reports

Subscriber and email tools are available only when enabled. Use approved audiences, respect communication preferences, and review the message, links, dates, and offer terms before scheduling or sending a campaign.

Reports may show sales totals, trends, top products, engagement, or forecasts. Use consistent filters when comparing periods, check unexpected values against source records, and treat forecasts as planning input rather than a guarantee.

title: Admin Panel
description: A concise guide for BeautyComm business clients managing their e-commerce store.
content:
BeautyComm is e-commerce software for businesses. This section is for the **business owner, administrator, or staff member** who uses the Admin Panel to run a store. Shoppers buying from that store should use the [User Portal](/docs/user-portal).

## Store Operations

The Admin Panel brings daily store work together: dashboard, products, inventory, orders, and customers. Start from the dashboard, open the relevant record, and confirm the correct store before making a change.

Product, stock, payment, and order records affect one another. Use approved product details, verify stock before confirming availability, and update order status only after the actual fulfillment step.

Open the [Store Operations guide](/docs/admin-panel/store-operations) for steps on products, orders, customer records, and sales channels.

<Screenshot alt="BeautyComm Admin Panel dashboard" label="Add a screenshot of the business Admin Panel dashboard with private data hidden" />

## Customers and Store Growth

BeautyComm supports customer and marketing features described in the product manual, including coupons, reviews, consultations, recommendations, influencers, donations, customer questions, testimonials, memberships, points, blogs, community posts, Glowtube video content, subscribers, email campaigns, sales reports, and forecasting.

Which features appear depends on the business setup. Follow customer consent and privacy rules, verify campaign dates and terms, and do not treat a recommendation or sales forecast as a guarantee.

See [Customers, Content, and Growth](/docs/admin-panel/customer-and-engagement-management) for the combined guide to these tools.

## Team and Access

Invite or update staff only when approved. Assign the least access needed for each role, review access when responsibilities change, and remove it when no longer required. Keep passwords, verification codes, and API credentials private.

See [Team and Account Administration](/docs/admin-panel/team-and-account-administration) for account and permission guidance.

## Store Setup and Technology

BeautyComm provides an e-commerce business workspace and a customer-facing store website. A mobile shopping app and integrations may also be available depending on the business setup. Store settings can include business details, shipping areas and charges, homepage content, banners, payment methods, notifications, social accounts, email delivery, and FAQs.

The product manual identifies supported delivery workflows such as Pathao and RedX. These are available only when configured for the store. External services and API credentials must be managed through approved secure processes.

The manual describes product capabilities and integrations, but does not verify programming languages, cloud provider, or hosting architecture. This guide therefore avoids naming an unconfirmed underlying technology stack.

See [Storefront and Platform Configuration](/docs/admin-panel/storefront-and-platform-configuration) for store details, checkout, and connected services.

## Support and Safety

Use activity records or system-status information when available and authorized. If a workflow fails, note the store, affected record or integration, time, and error. Contact your assigned BeautyComm business support channel. Do not include passwords, access tokens, or unnecessary customer details.

For shopping instructions, direct customers to the [User Portal](/docs/user-portal). For business setup and admin tasks, use the links in the Admin Panel navigation.

title: Stock, Suppliers, and Fulfillment
description: Check stock, maintain supplier information, and fulfill customer orders.
content:
Use this guide to keep products available and customer orders moving. Available supplier and delivery features depend on your BeautyComm store setup.

## Supplier Records and Orders

Keep supplier details and product associations accurate. Review supplier orders separately from customer orders; confirm the supplier, item, quantity, and status before acting.

<Screenshot alt="BeautyComm supplier records" label="Add a screenshot of supplier records and product associations" />

## Stock Levels and Requests

Search for the product and confirm the correct variant and store. Supplier stock may appear separately from stock held by the business. A low-stock alert signals that a quantity needs review; confirm the actual count before ordering.

<Screenshot alt="BeautyComm stock list" label="Add a screenshot of stock quantities and low-stock alerts" />

## Stock Adjustments

Record receipts, returns, damage, or count corrections only from a verified source. Confirm the product and stock record, enter the approved adjustment, and check the saved quantity. Follow the business approval process for stock requests and corrections.

## Customer Order Fulfillment

Before preparing an order, check its items, quantities, payment state, address, and current status. Update the order only after the related step—such as packing or dispatch—has occurred. Add tracking details where available.

## Delivery Providers

Use provider tools only when configured for your store. The product manual describes Pathao and RedX delivery workflows. Check the order reference and latest provider status before updating a customer. If tracking does not match, record the displayed status and contact support.

title: Store Operations
description: Manage the daily product, order, and customer tasks in the BeautyComm Admin Panel.
content:
Use this guide for everyday store work in the Admin Panel. Available actions depend on your role and the features enabled for the business.

## Dashboard and Navigation

Start from the dashboard to review available store summaries and alerts. Open the relevant section to make a change, and confirm you are working in the correct business or store before saving.

<Screenshot alt="BeautyComm Admin Panel dashboard" label="Add a screenshot of the business Admin Panel dashboard with private data hidden" />

## Products and Catalog

Create or update product details using information approved by the business. Check the product name, description, category, images, price, and variants before publishing. Confirm that product availability matches the current stock record.

<Screenshot alt="BeautyComm product catalog" label="Add a screenshot of the product list or product editor with business data hidden" />

## Orders and Customers

Open an order to review its items, payment state, customer details, delivery address, and current status. Update the order only after the related business step is complete. Keep customer records accurate and access personal information only when needed for an authorized task.

If something does not match, verify the order reference and store before making a correction. Follow the business process for cancellations, returns, and customer requests.

<Screenshot alt="BeautyComm order management" label="Add a screenshot of an order detail page with customer data hidden" />

## Sales Channels

Products may be displayed through the business storefront or other channels enabled for the store. Review the channel’s product details and availability after changes. Channel options and workflows vary by business configuration.

title: Storefront and Platform Configuration
description: Set up store information, shipping, payments, homepage content, and connected services.
content:
Store settings affect what shoppers see and how orders are placed. Change them only when authorized and check the storefront after saving.

## Business and Store Details

Confirm the correct business and store before changing shared information or preferences. Use approved business details and check how a setting may affect orders or customers.

## Shipping and Payment

Where configured, shipping settings may include delivery areas and charges. Payment settings determine which methods shoppers can choose at checkout. Confirm approved values with the responsible business owner, then test the checkout options.

## Homepage and Store Content

The store may provide homepage sections, banners, popups, and FAQs. Check text, images, links, dates, and display timing before publishing. Remove expired promotions and preview on mobile where possible.

<Screenshot alt="BeautyComm storefront configuration" label="Add a screenshot of homepage, banner, or popup settings" />

## Connected Services

This may include social accounts, email delivery, notifications, and delivery services. Connect only approved accounts. Email and API credentials are secrets; do not put them in screenshots or support tickets. Check the integration status and verify the related workflow after setup.

## Check a Configuration Change

After saving, confirm the new value and test the affected customer or staff workflow. If the result is wrong, note the store, setting, time, and observed behavior before contacting support.

title: Team and Account Administration
description: Manage authorized staff access and protect BeautyComm business accounts.
content:
Use the controls available to your role to manage team access. Follow your business approval process and give each person only the access needed for their work.

## Staff Accounts

Invite or update a staff member only when approved by the business. Check the email address and assigned role before saving. Review accounts when responsibilities change and remove access when it is no longer required.

<Screenshot alt="BeautyComm team accounts" label="Add a screenshot of the staff account list with personal data hidden" />

## Roles and Permissions

Assign the least access needed for a person to complete their tasks. Review the permissions associated with a role before assigning it, and use a separate approved process for administrator-level access.

## Account Security

Use a unique password and keep passwords, one-time codes, API keys, and other credentials private. Sign out on shared devices. Do not include secrets or unnecessary personal information in screenshots or support requests.

## Access Problems

Confirm the correct sign-in address and account, then use the approved password-recovery process if available. If access is still unavailable, contact the business’s assigned BeautyComm support channel with the affected account, time, and a brief description—never send a password or verification code.

title: Common Tasks
description: Use these everyday BeautyComm workflows to complete regular product, order, and account tasks.
content:
These task guides are for **BeautyComm client businesses and their authorized staff**. Use them for store setup, product work, stock updates, order processing, customer lookup, reporting, and business-account access. Shoppers should use the [Shopper Portal](/docs/user-portal) for help buying from a store.

## Set Up Your Business Account

Confirm you can sign in to the correct business account and see the areas needed for your role. Start with the [Business Admin Panel](/docs/admin-panel) to choose the right workflow.

## Manage Products and Stock

Search the catalog before adding a product. Confirm the correct item and variant, then update only approved details. For stock, use a verified receipt or count and check the saved quantity. See [Product and Catalog Management](/docs/user-portal/product-and-catalog-management) and [Inventory Management](/docs/user-portal/inventory-management).

## Find and Process an Order

Search by order reference or use available filters. Check the customer, items, payment state, and delivery details, then update the order only after the related step has occurred. See [Order Management](/docs/user-portal/order-management).

## Find Customers and Reports

Search customer records using an available identifier and confirm the correct person before reviewing details. For store performance, choose the report that matches your question and check its date range and filters.

## Fix Account Access

If sign-in fails or a menu is missing, check that you are using the right account and business. Ask an administrator to confirm the account is active and the role has the required access. For more help, see [Troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting) or [Support and Feedback](/docs/support).

title: Frequently Asked Questions
description: Answers for BeautyComm client businesses and shoppers using a BeautyComm-powered store.
content:
This FAQ serves both people who run a store with BeautyComm and customers who shop on a BeautyComm-powered store. Check the audience in each section: business-account permissions apply to store owners and staff, while shopping and mobile-app guidance applies to customers.

## BeautyComm for Businesses

BeautyComm is e-commerce software used by businesses to manage their store, products, stock, customer orders, engagement, and reporting. Business clients and their authorized teams use the [Business Admin Panel](/docs/admin-panel).

## Business Accounts and Permissions

These answers are for business clients and staff using their BeautyComm account. Shoppers do not need business-admin permissions to browse or buy from a store.

## Products, Orders, and Store Operations

These topics cover business workflows such as product listing, stock management, fulfillment, and customer records. For shopper order or delivery questions, contact the store that accepted the order.

## Customer Shopping and Mobile App

These answers are for customers browsing, checking out, or managing a purchase on a store website or supported mobile app. The store sets its own availability, payment, delivery, and return options. See the [Shopper Portal](/docs/user-portal).

## Privacy and Getting Support

Shoppers should contact the store using its published support details. Business clients should use the BeautyComm support contact assigned to their business. Never send passwords, one-time codes, or full payment-card details in support messages.

**Related guides:** [Getting Started](/docs/getting-started) · [Common Tasks](/docs/common-tasks) · [Support and Feedback](/docs/support)

title: Welcome to BeautyComm
description: Get started as a BeautyComm client business or find the correct guide as a customer shopping online.
content:
BeautyComm provides e-commerce software to businesses. This guide is for the business owner, administrator, or staff member setting up or operating a BeautyComm-powered store. If you are a shopper, go to the [Shopper Portal](/docs/user-portal) for help with shopping and customer accounts.

## BeautyComm and Your Store

BeautyComm is an e-commerce platform for beauty businesses. A business uses the admin workspace to manage its online storefront, products, stock, orders, customer engagement, marketing, and reports. Shoppers use that business’s website or supported mobile experience to discover and buy products.

## Who This Documentation Is For

This documentation serves two groups. **BeautyComm client businesses**—owners, administrators, and staff—should use the [Business Admin Panel](/docs/admin-panel). **Customers shopping at those businesses** should use the [Shopper Portal](/docs/user-portal) and, if applicable, the [Shopper Mobile App](/docs/mobile-app).

## Sign In and Choose Your Role

Before signing in, confirm the BeautyComm address assigned to your organization, your account identifier, and any verification process your business requires. If you are unsure which environment to use or your account is not active, ask your administrator or business support contact.

Open the sign-in page provided by your organization, enter your credentials, and complete any required verification. After signing in, the available workspace reflects your role. Sign out when you finish, especially on shared or public devices. Never share passwords or verification codes.

Your account identifies you and the business context you are using. Your role determines which areas and actions are available. If a feature is missing, confirm that you are in the correct environment and ask your administrator to check your assigned access.

## Navigate the Admin Panel

Start from the main navigation and choose the area that matches your task, such as catalog, inventory, orders, customers, or reports. Use search and filters to narrow lists, and open the relevant record to review details. Menu labels and available sections may vary.

## First Steps

Use this checklist after your account is ready:

1. Confirm that you can sign in to the correct environment.
2. Review the areas available to your role.
3. Identify the workflows you need for your job.
4. Check that the relevant product, stock, order, or customer information is visible.
5. Continue with [Common Tasks](/docs/common-tasks) for task-specific guidance.

If a workflow is missing or unclear, start with [Troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting) or contact your organization’s support channel.

title: Mobile App Guides
description: Guidance for customers browsing a BeautyComm-powered store and managing shopping activity from mobile.
content:
This section is for **customers shopping from a supported BeautyComm-powered mobile app**. Use it to find products, place and follow orders, and manage customer-account features. It is not the business admin app. Business owners and staff should use the [Business Admin Panel](/docs/admin-panel).

## What You Can Do

Depending on the store and app version, the mobile experience may include product browsing and search, product details, cart and checkout, order history and tracking, wishlist, profile, notifications, rewards, and support. The store decides which features are enabled.

For step-by-step shopping instructions, see [Shop and Place an Order](/docs/user-portal/storefront-and-shopping). For account information, see [Manage Your Customer Account](/docs/user-portal/customer-account).

## App Availability and Safety

Get the app from the store’s official website or an official app-store listing. If you are unsure whether an app is genuine, contact the store using the contact information on its official website. Do not install apps sent through an unexpected message, and never share your password or verification code with someone offering app support.

title: Shopper Profile and Notifications
description: Manage your customer profile and notification preferences in the mobile app.
content:
Customer account and device settings can vary by store, device, and app version. Use controls shown in the official app and keep your contact and delivery information accurate.

## Customer Profile

Confirm that the app is signed into the customer account you use with the store. Update the name, contact information, or delivery address where the app allows it. If a detail cannot be changed, contact the store through its published support channel.

## Device Permissions

Allow only the phone permissions needed for features you choose to use. Permission names and options depend on your device and operating system.

## Notification Preferences

Mobile notifications can be controlled by both app preferences and phone settings. Review both where available. If your phone is shared, consider whether order details should appear on the lock screen.

## Sign-In Problems

If sign-in fails or a session expires, check your connection and confirm that you are using the correct customer account for that store. Use the app’s official password-recovery option if needed. Contact the store through its official support channel if the problem continues. Never share passwords or verification codes.

title: Shopper App Setup and Sign-In
description: Install and access the official mobile shopping app for a BeautyComm-powered store.
content:
The shopper app is the mobile shopping experience offered by a BeautyComm-powered store. Each store may have its own app name, availability, supported devices, and installation instructions. Confirm that you are using the correct store’s official app.

## What the Shopper App Is For

The app may let you browse products, use a cart and checkout, check orders, save wishlist items, review rewards, and manage customer details. Available features depend on the store and app version. Business operations such as stock editing or staff access belong in the business admin workspace, not the shopper app.

## Supported Devices

Check the store’s official app listing for supported devices and operating-system versions. Make sure your device can connect to the internet and has enough available storage.

## Install the Official App

title: Shopper App Troubleshooting
description: Troubleshoot common customer mobile shopping and account problems.
content:
Use these checks to narrow down mobile shopping issues. App availability and recovery steps vary by store and device. For an order, payment, delivery, or return issue, contact the store that accepted the order.

## Install or Open the App

Confirm that you have the official app for the store and that your device meets its published requirements. Check available storage and install only from the official app-store listing or the store’s website.

## Customer Sign-In Problems

Check that you are signing in to the correct store account, verify your connection, and use the app’s password-recovery process if necessary. Do not send your password or verification code to support.

## Slow Loading or Network Issues

Check that your phone has a stable connection and retry the affected page or shopping step. If possible, compare with the store website. Avoid repeatedly submitting checkout or payment while a request is still processing.

## Update the App

Check for updates using the same official app-store source. Do not install packages from third-party download sites or unsolicited links.

## Contact the Store

When contacting the store, include the time, affected screen, app or device version if known, and the exact error message. For an order issue, include the order reference. Hide personal details in screenshots. Never send passwords, one-time codes, or full payment-card information.

Browse categories or search for an item, then review its description, images, price, available options, and availability. Select the correct variant before adding it to your cart. A cart item is not reserved, and stock or price may change before checkout.

Review your cart, delivery address, charges, promotion, and final total. Choose from the payment methods presented by the store. If the app appears to pause after payment, check for an order confirmation before trying again.

Open your customer account and select an order to review its items, payment state, current status, and delivery or tracking details where provided. Cancellation, return, refund, and invoice options depend on the store policy and order status. Contact the store if you need help.

## Wishlist and Rewards

If available, save products to your wishlist and review your rewards or points in the account area. Wishlist items are not reserved; price and availability can change. Reward earning and redemption follow the store’s current program terms.

## Notifications and Customer Support

Notifications may include order progress, offers, delivery updates, or store news. Open the account or order page to confirm details. For support, use the contact details published by the store and provide your order reference. Never send your password, one-time code, or full payment-card number.

content:

title: Support and Feedback
description: Reach the support team, share issues clearly, and provide feedback about the documentation.
content:
Support depends on whether you are a **shopper** or a **BeautyComm business client**. Shoppers should contact the store where they placed an order. Business owners and staff should use the BeautyComm support channel assigned to their business. This section explains what information to provide and how to send documentation feedback.

## How to Contact BeautyComm Support

**Business clients:** use the official BeautyComm support channel assigned to your business when the admin workspace or a platform feature is blocked.

**Shoppers:** for an order, payment, delivery, return, product, or customer-account issue, contact the store using the support details on its website or order confirmation. The store handles its own customer orders and policies.

## What Information to Provide When Reporting an Issue

A useful support request includes the relevant order or record reference, the date and time, the page or workflow, what you expected, what happened, and any error message. Add a screenshot only after hiding passwords, verification codes, payment details, and personal information that is not needed.

## How to Submit Documentation Feedback

Use the documentation feedback process when something is unclear, outdated, or missing. Include the page name, the confusion or problem, and any context that makes the issue easier to fix.

## Privacy and Legal Links

Review privacy and legal information for the business or product context relevant to your organization. These documents may cover policy, legal notices, or business obligations tied to account usage and support.

## Related guidance

* [Troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting)
* [FAQ](/docs/faq)
* [Getting Started](/docs/getting-started)

title: Troubleshooting
description: Use this guide to isolate the most common BeautyComm issues and identify the right next step.
content:
First identify which experience you are using. **BeautyComm business clients and staff** troubleshoot the Admin Panel and store-management workflows here. **Shoppers** should use the store’s published support contact for purchase, payment, delivery, or return problems.

## Login and Access

For a business account, confirm the correct business environment, account status, and assigned role. For a shopper account, confirm that you are signing in to the correct store account and use that store’s password-recovery process.

## Product and Inventory Issues

Problems with product visibility or inventory often involve the item not being published, stock not updating, or the wrong business context being selected. Review the product or stock record before escalating.

## Order and Customer Issues

For business teams, check the order or customer record, filters, permissions, and store context. Shoppers should contact the store with the order reference if their order is missing or its status is unclear.

## Reports and Integrations

Report and integration issues typically involve filters, missing data, or delayed processing. Confirm the scope of the report and whether the underlying data source is current before escalating a problem.

## Mobile Troubleshooting

For the shopper mobile app, check your network, app version, and customer sign-in. For an order or payment problem, contact the store. Business teams should contact their BeautyComm support channel for a problem in the admin workspace.

content:
Use your customer account to review shopping activity and manage the details saved with the store. Available options depend on that store.

## Account Home

Your account home may show recent orders, delivery updates, offers, reward information, or links to your profile and wishlist. Open the relevant page to confirm the full details; a summary may not show the latest status.

## Orders and Delivery

Select an order to review its reference, items, payment state, and delivery status. A tracking link, invoice, cancellation, or return option appears only when provided by the store and available for that order.

If an order is missing or unclear, contact the store using its published support information and include the order reference. Check for an order confirmation before retrying a checkout that appeared to pause.

If enabled, save products to your wishlist to revisit them later. A saved item is not reserved; its price and availability can change.

Some stores offer loyalty points, memberships, or referrals. Check the store’s current terms for earning and redeeming rewards. Contact the store if an order or points balance does not appear as expected.

## Help and Account Safety

Use the store’s official support channel for shopping, payment, delivery, or return questions. Provide the order reference and a brief description, but never send your password, one-time code, or full payment-card details.

title: Online Store and Shopping
description: A customer-friendly guide to discovering products, using the BeautyComm storefront, and completing an order.
content:
The BeautyComm storefront is the customer-facing place to discover products and shop. This guide explains the typical shopping journey from the home page to checkout. The exact layout, payment choices, delivery options, and promotions depend on the store configuration.

## Find Products

The storefront home page helps customers discover the store and its products. Depending on the current configuration, it may display promotional banners, featured products, categories, popular items, editorial content, or links to store information.

Start by choosing a category or using the store search. Promotional content can change over time, so review the offer details and validity before relying on a discount.

<Screenshot alt="BeautyComm storefront home page" label="Add a screenshot of the BeautyComm storefront home page" />

You can find products by browsing the available categories, subcategories, or brands, or by using search. Where the store provides filters, narrow results by options such as price, rating, availability, or new arrivals. Sorting controls may organize results by popularity, price, or recency.

To find an item:

1. Open the relevant category or enter a product name in search.
2. Apply available filters to narrow the results.
3. Sort the list if you want a particular order.
4. Open a product card to review the full product details.

If you do not see an expected product, clear restrictive filters and check another category or search term. Availability can change, and some products may not be listed for every store or customer.

<Screenshot alt="Product listing with search and filters" label="Add a screenshot of a product listing with search and filters" />

## Review Product Details

Before choosing a product, review its available images, description, specifications, price, discount information, and stock or availability indication. Some products have variants such as shade, size, color, or weight; choose the required option before adding the item to your cart.

Product pages may also show ratings, reviews, delivery information, and related products. Use the product details as the primary reference for what is being offered. If a variation is unclear or the information appears inconsistent, contact the store before placing the order.

<Screenshot alt="BeautyComm product details page" label="Add a screenshot of a BeautyComm product details page" />

## Cart and Checkout

The cart gives you a chance to review your selection before checkout. Check each item, variant, quantity, and displayed price. If the store supports promotional codes, apply the code in the cart or checkout and confirm that the discount appears in the order summary.

You can remove an item or change its quantity before continuing. Availability and price may change before an order is submitted, so review the latest summary rather than relying on an earlier product page.

Checkout collects the information needed to submit the order. Review the delivery address, item summary, applicable charges, promotion, and final total before confirming. The payment methods shown are the methods currently available to the store and your order; they can vary.

Typical checkout sequence:

1. Sign in or provide the customer details requested by the store.
2. Select or enter a delivery address.
3. Review shipping or delivery charges shown for that address.
4. Apply an eligible promotion or reward if the checkout offers it.
5. Choose one of the payment methods presented.
6. Review the complete order summary and submit the order.
7. Save the order reference shown after successful submission.

Do not submit payment more than once if the page appears to pause. Check for an order confirmation first, then contact the store’s support channel if the result is unclear.

<Screenshot alt="BeautyComm checkout and order review" label="Add a screenshot of the BeautyComm checkout summary" />

## Offers and Store Information

The storefront may show campaigns, discount banners, customer reviews, recommendations, or trust information. The exact content depends on the store. Check promotion terms, dates, eligible products, and any minimum conditions before applying an offer.

Store pages may also provide contact details, shipping or refund information, privacy terms, and other policies. Review these details before purchasing if you need to understand delivery, returns, or how the store handles customer information.

## Fix a Shopping Problem

If search returns no results, clear filters and try a broader term. If a cart total changes, review quantities, promotion eligibility, and delivery charges. If checkout does not complete, check for a confirmation or order reference before retrying. For a payment or order issue, contact the store through its published support channel and include the time and any order reference. Never send passwords, one-time codes, or full payment-card details in a support message.
